description: E37 at the model level, a fact with an end date after its day: a session is told that Sam brings the plywood for the shed roof next Friday, a curation run files it with that Friday as its end, and a run 30 days later, on the test clock (m2b curate --today), rewrites it: the distillate says the plywood was brought, and no fact file about it holds an end any more. Not compared: Claude Code's own memory keeps no end date to rewrite. Three wordings, one in German.

wordings.remember: Remember that Sam brings the plywood for the shed roof next Friday.
Merk dir, dass Sam nächsten Freitag das Sperrholz für das Schuppendach bringt.
Note for me: Sam is dropping off the plywood for the shed roof on Friday next week.
